title: Cook's membrane
sentence: The classic tapered, shear-loaded panel used to test bending accuracy in a distorted mesh.
theory: Cook's membrane has no closed form; the reference is the converged finite element value, $u_y \approx 23.9$ at the tip for plane stress with $\nu = 1/3$. It is a benchmark precisely because every element in it is distorted, so a formulation that only bends well on rectangles fails here.
